title: Etale cover carrying representatives of a pro-etale local Isom section
statement: For a scheme X, an étale object V over X, commutative ring B, and derived objects A,D on X's étale site, every section of the pro-étale presheaf of derived local isomorphisms between the comparison pullbacks of A and D over V is represented by actual derived isomorphisms on an étale covering of V.

source.place: Tags 09BV and 00WJ; local surjectivity of Isom sheafification on an étale object

proof.text: Apply local surjectivity of sheafification to the supplied pro-étale Isom section, simultaneously to its morphism and inverse components. Refine the resulting local representatives to a common étale cover. The two inverse equations are preserved under restriction, so each member of this cover carries an actual derived isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09BV and 00WJ; local surjectivity of Isom sheafification

lean.statement:
theorem exists_etale_iso_cover_of_proetale_local_iso_section
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (V : X.Etale)
    {B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing B]
    (A D : DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)))
    (s : (derivedLocalIsoPresheaf (ProEt.topology X) B
      ((derivedComparison X B).obj A)
      ((derivedComparison X B).obj D)).obj
        (op ((toProEt X).obj V))) :
    ∃ 𝒰 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage V.left,
      ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
        Nonempty ((localIsomorphismRestriction X B
          (Etale.mk (𝒰.f i ≫ V.hom))).obj A ≅
          (localIsomorphismRestriction X B
            (Etale.mk (𝒰.f i ≫ V.hom))).obj D)
